notes: Official USMLE Step 1 specifications rechecked 2026-08-30 support the nervous-system diagnosis classification.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Early seizures, developmental delay/ataxia, normal serum glucose and disproportionately low CSF glucose identify GLUT1 deficiency syndrome.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: PDH deficiency points toward lactate abnormalities; MCAD causes systemic fasting hypoglycemia; GLUT2 deficiency has hepatic/renal manifestations; MSUD has branched-chain amino-acid abnormalities.
